stepTitle: If the linear velocity of the ball relative to the elbow joint is $$20.0\,\text{m/s}$$ at a distance of $$0.480\, \text{m}$$ from the joint and the moment of inertia of the forearm is $$0.500\,\text{kg}\cdot\text{m}**2,$$ what is the rotational kinetic energy of the forearm? Give the energy to three significant figures (in $$\text{J})$$.
